title: Gov't work on September 28 suspended starting 1 p.m. for National Family Week
summary: Malacañang on Thursday suspended government work on September 28, starting at 1 p.m. to commemorate the 34th National Family Week.

blocks.text: Malacañang on Thursday suspended government work on September 28, starting at 1 p.m. to commemorate the 34th National Family Week.

This is in line with Proclamation 60, series of 1992, which declared the last week of September every year as Family Week. It also follows Proclamation 326, series of 2012 which declared the fourth Monday of every September as the “Kainang Pamilya Mahalaga" Day.

“Work in all agencies and instrumentalities of the National Government, including government-owned or -controlled corporations and state universities and colleges, shall be suspended on 28 September 2026 starting 1:00 in the afternoon.” Executive Secretary Ralph Recto said in Memorandum Circular 136.
However, government agencies whose functions involve the delivery of basic and health services and disaster response will continue their operations.
The Palace order also encouraged government workers in the executive branch to support activities in relation to National Family Week.

“The suspension of work in other branches of government, independent commissions or bodies, and the private sector is also encouraged to afford all Filipino families the full opportunity to celebrate the 34th National Family Week,” Recto wrote in the order.
The memorandum circular was signed on Wednesday but released to the public on Thursday. —Jean Mangaluz/LDF, GMA News
